limitations: Closure audit reads machine-emitted evidence and the ledger; it does not re-run the six verifiers (those are gated separately in npm run verify and re-run at closure).
Evidence-freshness check requires the evidence commit to be an ancestor of HEAD at audit time; the closure commits that pin the evidence land after the evidence commit by design (house pattern).
GitHub issue numbers are enforced against the values filed at milestone-32 creation time; if issues are renumbered on GitHub, EXPECTED_ISSUES here and the ledger must be updated together.
